title_en: Razer Announces 3 Translucent Green Peripherals to Mark Xbox's 25th Anniversary
summary_en: Gaming peripheral maker Razer has announced a trio of products to mark Xbox's 25th anniversary this Fall. The Xbox 25th Anniversary limited-edition collection consists of three translucent-green versions of flagship Razer products: an ergonomic mouse, a mechanical keyboard, and wireless earbuds. All three are available now.
body_en:
Gaming peripheral maker Razer has announced a trio of products to mark Xbox's 25th anniversary this Fall. The Xbox 25th Anniversary limited-edition collection consists of three translucent-green versions of flagship Razer products: an ergonomic mouse, a mechanical keyboard, and wireless earbuds. All three are available now.
The lineup, which, funnily enough, doesn't include an Xbox gamepad, nevertheless harkens back to the translucent emerald green color seen in a special-edition original-Xbox console and the original-Xbox "debug kits" that us media folks used to play in-development game builds. Here are the descriptions of each product, straight from Razer:
Microsoft itself is celebrating the Xbox's 25th anniversary with translucent green hardware of its own: a special-edition Xbox Series X console (that comes bundled with the perfectly good Halo: Campaign Evolved) and a matching controller . The actual anniversary arrives next month on November 15.
Ryan McCaffrey is IGN's executive editor of previews and host of IGN's weekly Xbox show, Podcast Unlocked , and a co-host of Next-Gen Console Watch . He's a North Jersey guy, so it's "Taylor ham," not "pork roll." Debate it with him on Twitter at @DMC_Ryan .
